question: What set of attributes is being ascribed to that supreme entity in this statement?
premises: That entity is designated as supreme.
It is ascribed partlessness and eternality.
It is ascribed freedom from disease and stainlessness.
inference: That entity is the supreme, partless, eternal, disease-free and stainless one.
plain_english: He is the supreme, partless, eternal, free from disease and stainless one.
